dataset: Korean Elementary Learning Map moral education subject workstream
subject: Moral Education
sourceBasis: Official NCIC 2022 revised moral education curriculum PDF [별책6] was located through the public NCIC inventory API, downloaded, and parsed with pdftotext. Elementary achievement-standard codes, grade bands, relationship domains, and source locations were checked against that extraction. Standard source bodies are not embedded.

textPolicy.summaryPolicy: Standard summaries, topic descriptions, and assessment prompts are source-derived paraphrases and decomposition labels; full official achievement-standard sentences are not reproduced.

sources.name: 교육부 고시 제2022-33호 [별책6] 도덕과 교육과정.pdf
sources.usage: Governing source for elementary moral education relationship-domain structure and achievement-standard code inventory. Full official standard text is not embedded.

notes: The previous v0.3 scaffold had 48 generic moral anchors; this subject artifact replaces that with 24 official elementary moral achievement-standard codes from the 2022 PDF.
Each official standard is decomposed into five candidate micro-topics: concept, case representation, inquiry procedure, dialogue/language, and reflective transfer.
Dependency suggestions are intentionally candidates for the integration card, not reviewed prerequisite facts.
The 2022 PDF uses 자연과의 관계 as the elementary fourth relationship domain; this artifact does not preserve the older 자연·초월과의 관계 label from the local placeholder seed.
